meta.name: weekly-digests
meta.description: Generate a serial week-by-week narrative digest of a project's full claude-mem timeline. Splits the timeline into per-ISO-week files, then runs one consecutive subagent per week — each receiving the prior week's carry-forward block — to produce one chapter per ISO week of data. Use when asked for "weekly digests", "week-by-week story", "serial timeline", or "narrative chapters" of a project's history.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果希望把项目记录自动整理成每周连续的叙事摘要
copy.tagline_en: Turn your project timeline into a week-by-week narrative.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want automatic weekly narrative summaries of your project history.

howto.what: 装上后,当你要求梳理某个项目的开发历史时,Claude 会把该项目的 claude-mem 时间线按 ISO 周切成每周一个文件,再逐周派一个子代理接力写出连载式周记,每周一章。章数等于覆盖的 ISO 周数,没有固定长度。
howto.when: 当你说「weekly digests」「week-by-week story」「serial timeline」等,或要求按周接着写项目故事时触发。想要单篇长报告应改用 timeline-report。

howto.what_en: When you ask Claude to digest a project's history, it splits the claude-mem timeline into one file per ISO week, then runs one subagent per week in sequence, writing one serial chapter per week. Chapter count equals the ISO weeks covered.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for "weekly digests," "week-by-week story," or "serial timeline" of a project's history, or want the story continued week by week. For one long report, use timeline-report instead.
